resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register places the tower at Uriah in Monroe County. Wikipedia places the community of Blacksher in Baldwin County and says Blacksher and Uriah were named for two brothers of one family (Jeptha Blacksher and James Uriah Blacksher). Neither source says why a Monroe County tower carries the Blacksher name. The story follows the Register's county.

notes_for_editor: NHLR is the only tower-specific source. The 1941 build year and 2009 registration in the brief match the Register. Height_m 36.6 is converted from the Register's 120-foot wording in its description, not from a separate height field, so check it if strict. The Forest Lookouts Blacksher page returns 404. Two WebSearch queries found no history beyond the Register. Status standing is taken from the Register's 'still standing' wording. No photos added: the NHLR photo us853_blacksher.jpg is already in the photo manifest and its license is not stated on the page.
